title: High-Salt Binding Buffer Reduces DnaK Co-Elution During Nickel Affinity Purification of a Recombinant Collagen-Like Protein
authors: Mina Vale, Theo Karst, and Liora Senn | Institute for Synthetic Bioprocess Benchmarks
research_question: Does increasing NaCl from 300 to 500 mM reduce DnaK co-elution during Ni-NTA purification of His10-ColX3 without a major loss of target recovery?
key_findings: 500 mM NaCl reduced the DnaK-to-ColX3 ratio 2.7-fold
ColX3 recovery decreased modestly from 5.6 to 5.1 mg/L
ATP/Mg2+ did not improve purity beyond high salt alone
conclusion: High-salt binding improved purity with a modest recovery cost; ATP/Mg2+ added no measurable benefit.
critical_negations: ATP-Mg2+ did not further improve purity
